messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] SLO breach detected on route `streaming-long` — p99 latency > 1.2s for last 5m (threshold 700ms). paging maya_oncall :rotating_light:

maya_oncall: on it. seeing a spike in p99 and also streaming stalls reported by clients. tagging @diego_eng @priya_sre

diego_eng: joining. quick question — did we just push the fp8 precision profile to streaming canary ~03:10 UTC?

anna_prod: yes, we finished canary rollout of `precision-profile/v2-fp8` at 03:08 per deploy-bot. low traffic canary for 10% then auto-promote.

priya_sre: logs show a correlated increase in dequant CPU time and KV cache misses for long-context sessions. suspect per-layer quant scale mismatch causing excessive dequant ops.

maya_oncall: can you paste the top traces?

priya_sre: pasting samples from traces: ```
# trace snippet (simplified)
span: runtime.kv_get   duration_ms=4  count=1000
span: runtime.dequant_layer duration_ms=34 count=1000
span: runtime.dequant_layer layer=11 duration_ms=120 count=120
span: runtime.generate token duration_ms=40  count=1200
error: dequant_scale_mismatch layer=11 expected=1.23 actual=0.00012
```

sam_reliability: that layer 11 explosion aligns with p99 tail. p95 up 30% too. streaming stalls observed (clients report partial chunking then stall).

maya_oncall: initial impact estimate? customer-facing?

anna_prod: monitoring shows ~8% of streaming requests from a set of high-throughput tenants hit p99 > 2s. top affected customers: ["AcmeAI-chat-prod", "OmniSearch-beta"] (internal IDs masked). CS flagged two paying customers experiencing degraded UX.

diego_eng: root cause hypothesis: the new calibration table for fp8 was generated with stale activation stats for a subset of layers (long-context sequences), so some layers get near-zero scales and runtime does expensive fallback dequant logic per token. Also KV cache format change might force extra copies.

priya_sre: corroborating — infra counters show per-VM CPU sys time jump and increased memcpy. Example log: ```
[03:18:42] host-12: memcpy bytes=524288 duration_us=4123
[03:18:42] host-12: dequant_copy layer=11 src_fmt=int8 dst_fmt=float32 duration_us=98765
```

maya_oncall: ok mitigation options: (1) immediate rollback of precision profile for `streaming-long` to fp16, (2) route streaming traffic to fp16 variant, (3) tweak calibration service to re-calc scales (slower). Which is fastest?

sam_reliability: (2) routing traffic to fp16 variant is fast and reversible. (1) rollback of profile is also quick but might affect other routes. prefer route-level fallback first.

diego_eng: agree. I'll patch routing to split traffic: 0% to fp8, 100% to fp16 for `streaming-long`. Doing via redwoodctl.

diego_eng: running: ```
redwoodctl routing update --route streaming-long --traffic-split "redwood/long-ctx-fp16:1.0" --reason "emergency fallback due to fp8 tail spikes"
```

deploy-bot: deploy started: routing update (id: route-9453) by diego_eng at 03:25 UTC

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: route-9453 promoted at 03:26 UTC

maya_oncall: metrics?

priya_sre: p99 coming down in the 1m window. pre-mitigation p99 ~1.9s, post ~580ms. p95 back under 400ms. streaming stall error reports dropping.

anna_prod: CS notified customers of active mitigation. escalation channel opened with account execs.

diego_eng: quick follow-up: I'll mark the fp8 profile canary as paused and create a rollback PR for `precision-profile/v2-fp8` -> `precision-profile/v1` calibration table.

sam_reliability: create an incident ticket and include correlation graphs (p95/p99, memcpy, dequant duration per layer) and the list of affected hosts.

maya_oncall: filing incident ticket now. severity: Sev2. ETA for full root cause analysis?

diego_eng: I'll re-run calibration on the long-context corpora with fresh activation stats and produce a new profile candidate. ETA ~3h for validation and a controlled canary.

priya_sre: additional action item: add a runtime guard to detect near-zero scales (threshold=1e-4) and short-circuit to fallback quantization path to avoid per-token dequant overhead. I'll open PR after postmortem.

anna_prod: customer impact notes: two customers briefly exceeded UX SLOs for ~20 minutes. No data loss. billing unaffected.

maya_oncall: handoff plan: I need to sign off in 30m then hand to diego for RCA and sam for remediation. Keeping this thread as live log.

incident-bot: oncall handoff scheduled: maya_oncall -> diego_eng at 04:00 UTC.

priya_sre: saving logs and extracting top-affected request ids: ```
affected_ids=["req-8f2a","req-8f2b","req-90c1"]
scp host-12:/var/log/runtime/dequant.log ./
```

diego_eng: note for postmortem: avoid broad auto-promote of precision profiles for streaming routes until per-layer scale validation completes. add canary weight ramping steps with p99 guard rails.

maya_oncall: thanks team. notify me if p99 creeps again. closing paging loop but keeping thread open for RCA updates. :white_check_mark:

anna_prod: adding post-incident customer notes and PR templates to the ticket.

sam_reliability: logging follow-ups: - add scale threshold alert, - add memcpy/dma counters to streaming dashboards, - add a canary fail-fast policy.

incident-bot: incident created: INC-2026-112, severity Sev2, owner: diego_eng.

(monitoring) 03:42 UTC snapshot: p99=580ms p95=360ms error-rate streaming-chunk-fail=0.4% (down from 3.6%)

maya_oncall: handing off. diego_eng owns RCA and remediation. sam_reliability owns observability changes. priya_sre owns runtime guard PR. anna_prod owns customer comms.

diego_eng: acknowledged. starting RCA doc now.

maya_oncall: thanks everyone, great response.
